ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (18) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Заблуждение» (zabluzhdeniye, 'error') is 'error' throughout, where the website draft alternated 'error', 'misconception', and 'delusion'; Schopenhauer's italic «разумение» (razumeniye) keeps the book's 'understanding', so «рассудок» (rassudok) is 'intellect' and «мышление» (myshleniye), Strakhov's 'organ of reason', is 'thinking'. «Известных понятий» (izvestnykh ponyatiy) is 'certain concepts', not 'well-known concepts'; the closing name «Федор Страхов» is 'Fyodor Strakhov' per D0003.
